local function Drag_generatedScript()
    local script = Instance.new('LocalScript')
    script.Name = "Drag"
    script.Parent = ImageLabel
    local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local gui = script.Parent
    local dragging
    local dragInput
    local dragStart
    local startPos
    local function update(input)
    	local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    	gui.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
    gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
    		dragging = true
    		dragStart = input.Position
    		startPos = gui.Position
    		
    		input.Changed:Connect(function()
    			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
    				dragging = false
    			end
    		end)
    	end
    end)
    gui.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
    		dragInput = input
    	end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    	if input == dragInput and dragging then
    		update(input)
    	end
    end)
end

local function LocalScript_generatedScript()
    local script = Instance.new('LocalScript')
    script.Name = "LocalScript"
    script.Parent = Road_Runner
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local player = Players.LocalPlayer
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
    local COOLDOWN_SECONDS = 8
    local NORMAL_FOV = 70
    local MAX_FOV = 120
    local FOV_LERP_SPEED = 8
    local FLASH_THRESHOLD = 99
    local MIN_SPEED = 50
    local MAX_SPEED = 399
    local RAMP_TIME = 3
    local BRAKE_DECEL = 600
    local BRAKE_THRESHOLD = 0.5
    local IDLE_ANIM_ID = "rbxassetid://78248850714817"
    local RUN_ANIM_ID = "rbxassetid://89672669390681"
    local BRAKE_ANIM_ID = "rbxassetid://78248850714817"
    local BRAKE_SOUND_ID = "rbxassetid://137696124683766"
    local FLASH_SOUND_ID = "rbxassetid://89600026835906"
    local RUN_SOUND_ID = "rbxassetid://93035214379043"
    local FLASH_FADE_IN_STEPS = 0.05
    local FLASH_FADE_OUT_STEPS = 0.03
    local FLASH_HOLD_DURATION = 0.15
    local FLASH_TICK = 0.016
    local isActive = false
    local isCooldown = false
    local connections = {}
    local flashGui = nil
    local flashFrame = nil
    local runSound = nil
    local flashSound = nil
    local SuperbirdBtn = script.Parent
    if not SuperbirdBtn:IsA("TextButton") then
    	warn("❌ This LocalScript must be placed inside a TextButton!")
    	return
    end
    local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 15)
    if not playerGui then
    	warn("❌ PlayerGui not found")
    	return
    end
    print("✅ Button found: " .. SuperbirdBtn.Name)
    local function FullReset()
    	isActive = false
    	for _, c in ipairs(connections) do
    		if c then c:Disconnect() end
    	end
    	table.clear(connections)
    	local char = player.Character
    	if char then
    		local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    		if hum then
    			hum.WalkSpeed = MIN_SPEED
    			local an = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    			if an then
    				for _, t in ipairs(an:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
    					t:Stop()
    				end
    			end
    		end
    		local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    		if hrp then
    			for _, s in ipairs(hrp:GetChildren()) do
    				if s:IsA("Sound") then s:Destroy() end
    			end
    		end
    	end
    	camera.FieldOfView = NORMAL_FOV
    	if flashGui then flashGui:Destroy() flashGui = nil end
    	if runSound then runSound:Stop() runSound = nil end
    	if flashSound then flashSound:Stop() flashSound = nil end
    	print("🔄 Reset complete")
    end
    local function StartSuperbird()
    	if isCooldown then return end
    	if isActive then FullReset() end
    	local character = player.Character
    	if not character then character = player.CharacterAdded:Wait() end
    	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    	local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    	local animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator")
    	isActive = true
    	isCooldown = true
    	SuperbirdBtn.AutoLocalize = false
    	task.spawn(function()
    		for i = COOLDOWN_SECONDS, 1, -1 do
    			SuperbirdBtn.Text = "Wait: "..i.."s"
    			task.wait(1)
    		end
    		SuperbirdBtn.Text = SuperbirdBtn.Name
    		isCooldown = false
    	end)
    	local function MakeAnim(id)
    		local a = Instance.new("Animation")
    		a.AnimationId = id
    		return a
    	end
    	local idleTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(MakeAnim(IDLE_ANIM_ID))
    	local runTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(MakeAnim(RUN_ANIM_ID))
    	local brakeTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(MakeAnim(BRAKE_ANIM_ID))
    	idleTrack.Looped = true
    	runTrack.Looped = true
    	local brakeSound = Instance.new("Sound")
    	brakeSound.Name = "BrakeSound_Superbird"
    	brakeSound.SoundId = BRAKE_SOUND_ID
    	brakeSound.Volume = 1
    	brakeSound.Parent = hrp
    	flashSound = Instance.new("Sound")
    	flashSound.Name = "FlashSound_Superbird"
    	flashSound.SoundId = FLASH_SOUND_ID
    	flashSound.Volume = 1
    	flashSound.Parent = hrp
    	runSound = Instance.new("Sound")
    	runSound.Name = "RunSound_Superbird"
    	runSound.SoundId = RUN_SOUND_ID
    	runSound.Volume = 0.8
    	runSound.Looped = true
    	runSound.Parent = hrp
    	-- FLASH GUI
    	flashGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    	flashGui.Name = "SpeedFlashGui"
    	flashGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    	flashGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    	flashGui.Parent = playerGui
    	flashFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    	flashFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    	flashFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    	flashFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    	flashFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    	flashFrame.Parent = flashGui
    	local currentSpeed = MIN_SPEED
    	local isMoving, isBraking, isIdle = false, false, false
    	local moveInputActive = false
    	local hasFlashed = false
    	local moveKeys = {
    		Enum.KeyCode.W, Enum.KeyCode.A, Enum.KeyCode.S, Enum.KeyCode.D,
    		Enum.KeyCode.Up, Enum.KeyCode.Down, Enum.KeyCode.Left, Enum.KeyCode.Right
    	}
    	local inputBegan = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    		if gpe or not isActive then return end
    		for _, k in ipairs(moveKeys) do
    			if input.KeyCode == k then
    				moveInputActive = true
    				return
    			end
    		end
    	end)
    	table.insert(connections, inputBegan)
    	local inputEnded = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    		if not isActive then return end
    		for _, k in ipairs(moveKeys) do
    			if input.KeyCode == k then
    				local stillDown = false
    				for _, k2 in ipairs(moveKeys) do
    					if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(k2) then
    						stillDown = true
    					end
    				end
    				moveInputActive = stillDown
    				return
    			end
    		end
    	end)
    	table.insert(connections, inputEnded)
    	local function PlayFlashEffect()
    		if flashSound then flashSound:Play() end
    		task.spawn(function()
    			for t = 0, 1, FLASH_FADE_IN_STEPS do
    				flashFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - t
    				task.wait(FLASH_TICK)
    			end
    			flashFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    			task.wait(FLASH_HOLD_DURATION)
    			for t = 0, 1, FLASH_FADE_OUT_STEPS do
    				flashFrame.BackgroundTransparency = t
    				task.wait(FLASH_TICK)
    			end
    			flashFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    		end)
    	end
    	local mainLoop = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    		if not isActive or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
    			FullReset()
    			return
    		end
    		local vel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    		local horizontalSpeed = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
    		local tryingToMove = moveInputActive and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.01
    		if tryingToMove and horizontalSpeed > 1 then
    			if isBraking then
    				isBraking = false
    				brakeTrack:Stop()
    			end
    			if not isMoving then
    				isMoving = true
    				if isIdle then isIdle = false; idleTrack:Stop() end
    				runTrack:Play()
    				if runSound then runSound:Play() end
    			end
    			if runSound then
    				local speedRatio = (currentSpeed - MIN_SPEED) / (MAX_SPEED - MIN_SPEED)
    				runSound.Volume = 0.4 + speedRatio * 0.6
    			end
    			currentSpeed = math.min(currentSpeed + (MAX_SPEED - MIN_SPEED) / RAMP_TIME * dt, MAX_SPEED)
    			humanoid.WalkSpeed = currentSpeed
    			local ratio = (currentSpeed - MIN_SPEED) / (MAX_SPEED - MIN_SPEED)
    			camera.FieldOfView += (NORMAL_FOV + (MAX_FOV - NORMAL_FOV) * ratio - camera.FieldOfView)
    				* math.min(dt * FOV_LERP_SPEED, 1)
    			if currentSpeed >= FLASH_THRESHOLD and not hasFlashed then
    				hasFlashed = true
    				PlayFlashEffect()
    			end
    		elseif not tryingToMove and horizontalSpeed > BRAKE_THRESHOLD then
    			if not isBraking then
    				isBraking = true
    				isMoving = false
    				runTrack:Stop()
    				if runSound then runSound:Stop() end
    				if isIdle then isIdle = false; idleTrack:Stop() end
    				brakeTrack:Play()
    				brakeSound:Play()
    			end
    			currentSpeed = math.max(currentSpeed - BRAKE_DECEL * dt, MIN_SPEED)
    			humanoid.WalkSpeed = currentSpeed
    			camera.FieldOfView += (NORMAL_FOV - camera.FieldOfView) * math.min(dt * FOV_LERP_SPEED, 1)
    		else
    			if isBraking then
    				isBraking = false
    				brakeTrack:Stop()
    			end
    			if isMoving then
    				isMoving = false
    				runTrack:Stop()
    				if runSound then runSound:Stop() end
    			end
    			if not isIdle then
    				isIdle = true
    				idleTrack:Play()
    			end
    			currentSpeed = MIN_SPEED
    			humanoid.WalkSpeed = MIN_SPEED
    			hasFlashed = false
    			camera.FieldOfView += (NORMAL_FOV - camera.FieldOfView) * math.min(dt * FOV_LERP_SPEED, 1)
    		end
    	end)
    	table.insert(connections, mainLoop)
    	-- RESET ON RESPAWN
    	local respawnCheck = character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
    		if not parent then FullReset() end
    	end)
    	table.insert(connections, respawnCheck)
    	print("✅ Superbird activated")
    end
    SuperbirdBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(StartSuperbird)
    print("✅ Ready — Click your button to start!")
    task.spawn(function()
    	task.wait(1)
    	StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
    		Title = "Credit",
    		Text = "Hey! there " .. player.Name .. " This Script was Create By Venora!",
    		Duration = 5,
    	})
    end)
end

scripts.features:
FluentHeart's older brother.
[OPEN SOURCE]

Movement
WalkSpeed & JumpPower Sliders: Adjust character movement speed (16–250) and jump height (50–300).

Instant Stop (Disable Sliding): Removes character deceleration so you stop moving immediately when keys are released.

Custom Gravity & Slope Angle: Adjustable gravity control and 360° MaxSlopeAngle toggle to walk up vertical surfaces.

No Void Protection: Lowers the void kill-boundary height so you don't die or get destroyed when falling off the map.

Camera & FOV Controls: Field of view slider (60–120) and extended camera zoom distance slider (up to 12,800 studs).

Float Platform: Spawns an anchored platform beneath your feet with customizable vertical offset and Q/E key controls for moving up and down.

Waypoint System: Save up to 50 custom position waypoints, teleport to saved points, delete waypoints, or TP directly to any active game SpawnLocation.

Position & Axis Tools: One-click copy for current CFrame coordinates to clipboard and snap character facing direction directly North.

Teleport Tool: Equips a click-to-teleport tool in your inventory.

Players & Tracking
Player Teleport: Select any player from a dropdown list to instantly teleport to their location.

Latch Onto Player: Teleports to a chosen player and automatically teleports you back to your starting position once turned off.

Spectate Camera & Beam Tracer: Spectate target player viewports with a visual beam tracer drawing a line between your character and theirs.

Low HP Tracker: Audio alerts and notifications when surrounding players drop below 35 HP.

Death Logger & Teleport: Automatically logs player death coordinates (including void deaths) with timestamps and allows you to teleport to where they died.

Visuals & Rendering
Lighting Adjustments: Fullbright toggle, disable fog, and global shadow toggle.

Potato Graphics: Converts world materials to Smooth Plastic for more FPS on lower-end devices.

Player ESP: Wall-penetrating highlights and Billboard text displaying player names and real-time health (with range, font size, Y-offset, and transparency sliders).

NPC ESP: Separate highlight and text display for non-player humanoids in workspace.

Instance Path Evaluator: Evaluates string expressions or property paths (e.g., workspace.spawn:GetChildren()[1]) and highlights matched parts through walls.

Utilities & Diagnostics
Player Activity Logger: Tracks player leave events and session durations with queued notification popups.

Integrated Script Launchers: One-click execution for UniversalSynSaveInstance and Infinite Yield.

Workspace Scanner: Scans workspace to count anchored parts, unanchored parts, tools, players, and NPCs.

Live Performance Tracker: Monitors real-time FPS, network latency (Ping in ms), and total Memory usage (MB).

Customization & Configurations
Custom UI Keybind: Remap the UI toggle key (default is Right Control).

Sound Customization: Select sound IDs and adjust volumes for Low HP, Player Left, and General UI notifications.

Linoria Config & Theme Manager: Save, load, and auto-load script profiles or customize UI theme colors.

Telemetry & Usage Stats: Optional feature counter that logs script session metrics to the developer console (F9).

if _G.OriginalLighting == nil then

        Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
        Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
        GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
        FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
        FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
    }
end
if _G.OriginalGravity == nil then _G.OriginalGravity = workspace.Gravity end
if _G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom == nil then _G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom = LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance end
if _G.OriginalFallenPartsDestroyHeight == nil then _G.OriginalFallenPartsDestroyHeight = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight end

local function getSafeGuiContainer()
    if typeof(gethui) == "function" then
        local success, result = pcall(gethui)
        if success and result then return result end
    end
    local success, coreGui = pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
    if success and coreGui then return coreGui end
    return LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local SafeGuiContainer = getSafeGuiContainer()

local function purgeOldUI()
    local targets = {SafeGuiContainer}
    pcall(function() table.insert(targets, game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
    pcall(function() table.insert(targets, LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")) end)

    for _, container in ipairs(targets) do
        if container then
            for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("ScreenGui") and (
                    child.Name:lower():find("linoria") or 
                    child.Name:lower():find("universal") or 
                    child:FindFirstChild("Main") or 
                    child:FindFirstChild("ResizeGripHandle") or
                    child:FindFirstChild("Screen")
                ) then
                    pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- If script was already executed, trigger full cleanup & unload LinoriaLib
if _G.UniversalHubCleanup then
    pcall(_G.UniversalHubCleanup)
end
if _G.UniversalHubLibrary then
    pcall(function() _G.UniversalHubLibrary:Unload() end)
    _G.UniversalHubLibrary = nil
end
purgeOldUI()

Lighting.GlobalShadows = true

local spectateAtt0 = nil

    if spectateBeam then pcall(function() spectateBeam:Destroy() end) spectateBeam = nil end
    if spectateAtt0 then pcall(function() spectateAtt0:Destroy() end) spectateAtt0 = nil end
    if spectateAtt1 then pcall(function() spectateAtt1:Destroy() end) spectateAtt1 = nil end

    if customHighlightFolder then
        customHighlightFolder:ClearAllChildren()
    end
    table.clear(playerHighlights)
    table.clear(npcHighlights)
end

_G.UniversalHubCleanup = function()
    activeLoops[1] = false
    
    for _, conn in ipairs(connections) do
        if conn and conn.Connected then
            conn:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    table.clear(connections)

    removeSpectateTracer()
    clearAllCustomHighlights()

    if customHighlightFolder then customHighlightFolder:Destroy() end

    if workspace:FindFirstChild("UniversalFloatPlatform") then
        workspace.UniversalFloatPlatform:Destroy()
    end

    -- Reset Camera State
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if cam then
        cam.FieldOfView = 70
        if LocalPlayer.Character then
            local hum = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hum then cam.CameraSubject = hum elseif hrp then cam.CameraSubject = hrp end
        end
        cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    end

    -- Reset Character Physics & Stats to Default
    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum.WalkSpeed = 16
            hum.JumpPower = 50
            hum.UseJumpPower = true
            hum.MaxSlopeAngle = 45
        end
    end

    -- Restore Game Environment Settings
    if _G.OriginalLighting then
        Lighting.Brightness = _G.OriginalLighting.Brightness
        Lighting.Ambient = _G.OriginalLighting.Ambient
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = _G.OriginalLighting.GlobalShadows
        Lighting.FogEnd = _G.OriginalLighting.FogEnd
        Lighting.FogStart = _G.OriginalLighting.FogStart
    end

    if _G.OriginalGravity ~= nil then workspace.Gravity = _G.OriginalGravity end
    if _G.OriginalFallenPartsDestroyHeight ~= nil then workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = _G.OriginalFallenPartsDestroyHeight end
    if _G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom ~= nil then LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = _G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom end

    -- Unload Linoria Library Instance
    if _G.UniversalHubLibrary then
        pcall(function() _G.UniversalHubLibrary:Unload() end)
        _G.UniversalHubLibrary = nil
    end

    purgeOldUI()
end

local floatPlatform = nil
local function updateFloatPlatform(dt)
    if not floatEnabled then
        if floatPlatform then floatPlatform:Destroy() floatPlatform = nil end
        floatBaseY = nil
        return
    end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if hrp and hum then
        local hipOffset = (hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15) and (hum.HipHeight + 1.2) or 3.0
        local targetY = hrp.Position.Y - hipOffset

        if not floatBaseY or math.abs(targetY - floatBaseY) > 15 then
            floatBaseY = targetY
        end

        local verticalSpeed = floatSpeedValue * dt
        if qeControlEnabled then
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E) then
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, verticalSpeed, 0)
                floatBaseY = floatBaseY + verticalSpeed
            elseif UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, verticalSpeed, 0)
                floatBaseY = floatBaseY - verticalSpeed
            end
        end

        if not floatPlatform or not floatPlatform.Parent then
            floatPlatform = Instance.new("Part")
            floatPlatform.Name = "UniversalFloatPlatform"
            floatPlatform.Size = Vector3.new(6, 1, 6)
            floatPlatform.Anchored = true
            floatPlatform.CanCollide = true
            floatPlatform.Transparency = 0.9
            floatPlatform.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
            floatPlatform.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
            floatPlatform.Parent = Workspace
        end
        
        floatPlatform.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position.X, floatBaseY + floatYOffset, hrp.Position.Z)
    end
end

    if BodyGyro then BodyGyro:Destroy() BodyGyro = nil end
    local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        hum.PlatformStand = false
    end
end

local function startFly()
    local root = getRoot()
    local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not root or not hum then return end

    Flying = true
    setFlyVisual(true)

    BodyVel = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    BodyVel.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    BodyVel.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    BodyVel.Parent = root

    BodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    BodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    BodyGyro.P = 9e4
    BodyGyro.Parent = root

    hum.PlatformStand = true

    Conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not Flying or not root or not root.Parent then
            stopFly()
            return
        end

        local camCF = Camera.CFrame
        local move = Vector3.zero

        if Keys.W then move = move + camCF.LookVector end
        if Keys.S then move = move - camCF.LookVector end
        if Keys.A then move = move - camCF.RightVector end
        if Keys.D then move = move + camCF.RightVector end

        -- вертикаль от кнопок + клавиш
        local up = Vertical
        if Keys.Space then up = up + 1 end
        if Keys.Ctrl  then up = up - 1 end

        if move.Magnitude > 0 then
            move = move.Unit * Speed
        end
        move = move + Vector3.new(0, up * Speed, 0)

        BodyVel.Velocity = move
        BodyGyro.CFrame = camCF
    end)
end

		local SHOT_SPEED = 180

		local EXPLOSION_RADIUS = 12

		local ROCKET_INITIAL_ARC   = 0.45
		local ROCKET_STEER_P       = 2500

		local ROCKET_SLOWDOWN_DIST = 25

		local WHOOSH_START_VOLUME = 2
		local WHOOSH_FADE_START   = 15

		-- === OBSTACLE AVOIDANCE ===
		local ROCKET_OBSTACLE_LOOKAHEAD   = 100
		local ROCKET_OBSTACLE_AVOID_PULL  = 3.2
		local ROCKET_AVOID_BLEND          = 0.85

		local ROCKET_MAX_LEAD_TIME = 0.75
		local ROCKET_MIN_LEAD_SPEED = 2

		local ROCKET_TERMINAL_LOCK_DIST = 30
		local ROCKET_OVERSHOOT_DIST = 12

		-- === EXPLOSION TUNING ===
		local EXPLOSION_BLAST_PRESSURE   = 0     -- Keeps explosion visual & instance active, but strips out default engine kill force
		local BLAST_KNOCKBACK_STRENGTH   = 250   
		local NPC_KNOCKBACK_STRENGTH     = 110   

		local PlayersService     = Game:GetService('Players')
		local DebrisService      = Game:GetService('Debris')
		local RunService         = Game:GetService('RunService')
		local SoundService       = Game:GetService('SoundService')
		local UserInputService   = Game:GetService('UserInputService')

		local Workspace = workspace
		local LocalPlayer = PlayersService.LocalPlayer

		local Tool = script.Parent
		local Handle = Tool:WaitForChild('Handle')
		local ReloadSound = Handle:WaitForChild('Reload')

		local Character, Humanoid, Player = nil, nil, nil
		local BaseShot = nil

		local ActiveShot     = nil
		local ActiveWhoosh   = nil
		local ActiveUpdateConn = nil

		local function cleanupActive()
			if ActiveUpdateConn then
				ActiveUpdateConn:Disconnect()
				ActiveUpdateConn = nil
			end
			if ActiveWhoosh then
				ActiveWhoosh:Stop()
				ActiveWhoosh:Destroy()
				ActiveWhoosh = nil
			end
			if ActiveShot then
				ActiveShot = nil
			end
		end

		local function playAtPosition(soundId, position, volume, pitch)
			local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
			anchor.Anchored = true
			anchor.CanCollide = false
			anchor.Transparency = 1
			anchor.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
			anchor.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
			anchor.Parent = Workspace

			local s = Instance.new("Sound")
			s.SoundId = soundId
			s.Volume = volume or 2
			s.Pitch = pitch or 1
			s.RollOffMaxDistance = 500
			s.RollOffMinDistance = 5
			s.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
			s.Parent = anchor

			s:Play()
			DebrisService:AddItem(anchor, 5)
		end

		local function WeOwnCharacter(character)
			if not character or not character.Parent then return false end
			local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				or character.PrimaryPart
			if not root then return false end
			local owner = nil
			pcall(function() owner = root:GetNetworkOwner() end)
			return owner == LocalPlayer
		end

		local function TryTakeOwnership(character)
			if not character or not character.Parent then return false end
			local gotAny = false
			for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then
					local ok = pcall(function()
						part:SetNetworkOwner(LocalPlayer)
					end)
					if ok then gotAny = true end
				end
			end
			return gotAny
		end

		local function ApplyDamageStack(humanoid, damage)
			if not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent then return end
			if damage and damage > 0 then
				pcall(function() humanoid:TakeDamage(damage) end)
			end
			if not damage then
				pcall(function() humanoid.Health = -1 end)
				pcall(function() humanoid:TakeDamage(9999999999) end)
			elseif humanoid.Health > 0 and damage >= 9999999 then
				pcall(function() humanoid.Health = -1 end)
				pcall(function() humanoid:TakeDamage(9999999999) end)
			end
		end

		local function ReliableKill(character, humanoid)
			task.spawn(function()
				ApplyDamageStack(humanoid)

				if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

				for _ = 1, 20 do
					if not character.Parent or not humanoid.Parent then return end
					if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

					if not WeOwnCharacter(character) then
						TryTakeOwnership(character)
					end
					ApplyDamageStack(humanoid)
					task.wait(0.1)
				end
			end)
		end

		local EXPLOSION_DAMAGE_BANDS = {
			{0.50, 9999999},
			{0.58, 0.90},
			{0.67, 0.70},
			{0.75, 0.50},
			{0.83, 0.35},
			{0.92, 0.20},
			{1.00, 0.10},
		}

		local function damageFractionForRatio(ratio)
			for _, band in ipairs(EXPLOSION_DAMAGE_BANDS) do
				if ratio <= band[1] then
					return band[2]
				end
			end
			return 0
		end

		local function isPlayerCharacter(char)
			if not char then return false end
			local ok, plr = pcall(function()
				return PlayersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
			end)
			return ok and plr ~= nil
		end

		local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
		overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {}

		local function applyExplosion(pos)
			local radius   = EXPLOSION_RADIUS
			local propKb   = BLAST_KNOCKBACK_STRENGTH
			local npcKb    = NPC_KNOCKBACK_STRENGTH

			local parts = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(pos, radius, overlapParams)
			local seenChars = {}

			for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
				local char = nil
				local node = part
				for _ = 1, 4 do
					if not node or node == Workspace then break end
					node = node.Parent
					if node and node:IsA("Model")
						and node:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
						char = node
						break
					end
				end

				if char then
					if not seenChars[char] then
						seenChars[char] = true

						local hum  = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
						local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

						if hum and root and hum.Health > 0
							and char ~= Character
							and not isPlayerCharacter(char) then

							local d = (root.Position - pos).Magnitude
							if d <= radius then

								if not root.Anchored then
									local delta = root.Position - pos
									local dir
									if delta.Magnitude < 0.01 then
										dir = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
									else
										dir = delta.Unit
									end
									dir = (dir + Vector3.new(0, 0.55, 0)).Unit

									local falloff = 1 - (d / radius)
									local mass = root:GetMass()
									local impulse = dir * (npcKb * falloff) * mass

									pcall(function()
										root:ApplyImpulse(impulse)
									end)
								end

								local frac = damageFractionForRatio(d / radius)

								if frac > 1 then
									ReliableKill(char, hum)
								else
									local damage =
										(hum.MaxHealth > 0 and hum.MaxHealth or 100) * frac

									task.spawn(function()
										if not WeOwnCharacter(char) then
											for _ = 1, 5 do
												if not char.Parent or not hum.Parent
													or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
												TryTakeOwnership(char)
												if WeOwnCharacter(char) then break end
												task.wait(0.05)
											end
										end

										if not char.Parent or not hum.Parent then return end
										if hum.Health <= 0 then return end

										ApplyDamageStack(hum, damage)
									end)
								end
							end
						end
					end
				elseif part:IsA("BasePart") and not part.Anchored then
					local delta = part.Position - pos
					local d = delta.Magnitude
					if d <= radius and d > 0.01 then
						local falloff = 1 - (d / radius)
						local mass = part:GetMass()
						local impulse = delta.Unit * (propKb * falloff) * mass
						pcall(function() part:ApplyImpulse(impulse) end)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local function killSounds(part)
			if not part then return end
			for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Sound") then
					child.Looped = false
					child:Stop()
					child:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end

		local shotTargets = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

		local function OnTouched(shot, otherPart, detonatePosition)
			if not shot or not shot.Parent then return end
			if shot:GetAttribute("Hit") then return end

			if otherPart then
				if not shot:GetAttribute("Armed") then
					local tgt = shotTargets[shot]
					if not (tgt and otherPart:IsDescendantOf(tgt)) then
						return
					end
				end
				local allowSelf = shot:GetAttribute("AllowSelfHit") == true
				if (not allowSelf) and Character and otherPart:IsDescendantOf(Character) then
					return
				end
			end

			shot:SetAttribute("Hit", true)

			local pos = detonatePosition or shot.Position

			cleanupActive()
			killSounds(shot)
			shot:Destroy()

			-- Spawns the standard visual explosion object, but with 0 blast pressure so your custom damage bands handle the kills safely
			local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
			explosion.BlastRadius = EXPLOSION_RADIUS
			explosion.BlastPressure = EXPLOSION_BLAST_PRESSURE
			explosion.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0
			explosion.Position = pos
			explosion.Parent = Workspace

			applyExplosion(pos)

			playAtPosition(EXPLOSION_SOUND_ID, pos, 2.5, 1)
		end

		local function OnEquipped()
			Character = Tool.Parent
			Humanoid = Character:WaitForChild('Humanoid')
			Player = PlayersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
		end

		local function nozzleCFrame(position, forward)
			forward = forward.Magnitude > 1e-4 and forward.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)

			local upRef = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			if math.abs(forward:Dot(upRef)) > 0.99 then
				upRef = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
			end

			local vZ = -forward
			local vY = (upRef - vZ * vZ:Dot(upRef)).Unit
			local vX = vY:Cross(vZ)
			return CFrame.fromMatrix(position, vX, vY, vZ)
		end

		local function closestPointOnSegment(A, B, P)
			local ab = B - A
			local abLen2 = ab:Dot(ab)
			if abLen2 < 1e-6 then
				return (P - A).Magnitude, A
			end
			local t = (P - A):Dot(ab) / abLen2
			t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
			local closest = A + ab * t
			return (P - closest).Magnitude, closest
		end

		local function findClickTarget()
			local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not camera then
				return { staticPosition = Humanoid and Humanoid.TargetPoint or Vector3.new() }
			end

			local mouseLocation = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(mouseLocation.X, mouseLocation.Y)

			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			local excludeList = {}
			if Handle then table.insert(excludeList, Handle) end
			if ActiveShot then table.insert(excludeList, ActiveShot) end
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excludeList

			local result = Workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * MAX_CLICK_RANGE, params)

			if not result then
				local fallback = Humanoid and Humanoid.TargetPoint or (ray.Origin + ray.Direction * 100)
				return { staticPosition = fallback }
			end

			local hitPart = result.Instance

			local currentModel = hitPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			while currentModel do
				local modelHumanoid = currentModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local rootPart = currentModel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					or (modelHumanoid and modelHumanoid.RootPart)
					or (modelHumanoid and modelHumanoid.Torso)

				if modelHumanoid or rootPart then
					return {
						npc            = currentModel,
						humanoid       = modelHumanoid,
						rootPart       = rootPart or hitPart,
						hitPosition    = result.Position,
						staticPosition = result.Position,
					}
				end

				currentModel = currentModel:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			end

			return {
				staticPosition = result.Position,
				hitPart        = hitPart,
			}
		end

		local function shouldDodgeObstacle(hitPart)
			local node = hitPart
			local topModel = nil
			for _ = 1, 6 do
				if not node or node == Workspace then break end
				if node:IsA("Model") then
					if node:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
						return false
					end
					topModel = node
				end
				node = node.Parent
			end

			local size
			if topModel then
				local ok, bbox = pcall(function()
					return topModel:GetExtentsSize()
				end)
				if ok and bbox then
					size = bbox
				end
			end
			if not size then
				size = hitPart.Size
			end

			local axes = {size.X, size.Y, size.Z}
			table.sort(axes)
			if axes[1] < 3 and axes[2] < 3 then
				return false
			end

			return true
		end

		local function findAvoidanceDir(origin, desiredDir, params, maxLen)
			local lookLen = math.min(ROCKET_OBSTACLE_LOOKAHEAD, maxLen or ROCKET_OBSTACLE_LOOKAHEAD)

			local hit = Workspace:Raycast(origin, desiredDir * lookLen, params)
			if not hit then return nil, 0 end

			if not shouldDodgeObstacle(hit.Instance) then
				return nil, 0
			end

			local hitDist = (hit.Position - origin).Magnitude
			local strength = math.clamp(1 - (hitDist / lookLen), 0, 1)
			strength = strength ^ ROCKET_AVOID_RAMP_EXP

			local up = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			if math.abs(desiredDir:Dot(up)) > 0.95 then
				up = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
			end
			local right = desiredDir:Cross(up).Unit
			local left = -right
			local down = -up

			local candidates = {
				right, left,
				(right + up).Unit,   (left + up).Unit,
				(right + down).Unit, (left + down).Unit,
				up, down,
			}
			local bestDir, bestScore = nil, -math.huge

			for _, side in ipairs(candidates) do
				local candidate = (desiredDir + side * ROCKET_OBSTACLE_AVOID_PULL).Unit
				local test = Workspace:Raycast(origin, candidate * lookLen, params)
				local clearance
				if test then
					clearance = (test.Position - origin).Magnitude
				else
					clearance = lookLen
				end
				local score = clearance + candidate:Dot(desiredDir) * 6
				if candidate.Y < -0.3 then
					score = score - 8
				end
				if score > bestScore then
					bestScore, bestDir = score, candidate
				end
			end

			return bestDir, strength
		end

		local function OnActivated()
			if Tool.Enabled and Humanoid.Health > 0 then
				Tool.Enabled = false

				cleanupActive()

				local handleCFrame = Handle.CFrame
				local firingPoint = handleCFrame:PointToWorldSpace(MUZZLE_LOCAL_OFFSET)

				local clickTarget = findClickTarget()

				local initialTargetPos
				if clickTarget.npc and clickTarget.rootPart and clickTarget.rootPart.Parent then
					initialTargetPos = clickTarget.rootPart.Position
				else
					initialTargetPos = clickTarget.staticPosition
				end

				local aimVec = initialTargetPos - firingPoint
				if aimVec.Magnitude < 1e-3 then
					aimVec = handleCFrame.lookVector * 100
					initialTargetPos = firingPoint + aimVec
				end

				local targetDistance = (initialTargetPos - firingPoint).Magnitude

				local arcAmount = 0
				if targetDistance > ROCKET_ARC_MIN_DIST then
					local t = math.clamp(
						(targetDistance - ROCKET_ARC_MIN_DIST) /
						(ROCKET_ARC_FULL_DIST - ROCKET_ARC_MIN_DIST),
						0, 1)
					arcAmount = ROCKET_INITIAL_ARC * t
				end

				local initialForward = (aimVec.Unit + Vector3.new(0, arcAmount, 0)).Unit

				local shot = BaseShot:Clone()
				local initialCF = nozzleCFrame(firingPoint + initialForward * ROCKET_FORWARD_OFFSET, initialForward)
				shot.CFrame = initialCF
				ActiveShot = shot

				if clickTarget.npc then
					shotTargets[shot] = clickTarget.npc
				end
				task.delay(ROCKET_ARM_TIME, function()
					if shot and shot.Parent then
						shot:SetAttribute("Armed", true)
					end
				end)

				local isSelfTarget = (clickTarget.npc ~= nil and clickTarget.npc == Character)
				if isSelfTarget then
					shot:SetAttribute("AllowSelfHit", true)
				end

				local targetPart = nil
				if clickTarget.npc and clickTarget.rootPart and clickTarget.rootPart.Parent then
					targetPart = clickTarget.rootPart
				end

				local whoosh = Instance.new("Sound")
				whoosh.Name = "RocketWhoosh"
				whoosh.SoundId = "rbxasset://sounds/Rocket whoosh 01.wav"
				whoosh.Looped = true
				whoosh.Volume = WHOOSH_START_VOLUME
				whoosh.Parent = SoundService
				ActiveWhoosh = whoosh

				local gyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
				gyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
				gyro.P = ROCKET_STEER_P
				gyro.D = ROCKET_STEER_D
				gyro.CFrame = initialCF
				gyro.Parent = shot

				local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
				bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
				bodyVelocity.Velocity = initialForward * SHOT_SPEED
				bodyVelocity.Parent = shot

				local lastPos = shot.Position
				local committedAvoidDir, committedAvoidUntil = nil, 0
				local terminalLock = false

				local ignoreList = {shot, Handle}
				if Character then table.insert(ignoreList, Character) end
				if clickTarget.npc then table.insert(ignoreList, clickTarget.npc) end

				local avoidParams = RaycastParams.new()
				avoidParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				avoidParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreList
				avoidParams.IgnoreWater = true

				local updateConn
				updateConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
					if not shot or not shot.Parent then
						if updateConn then updateConn:Disconnect() end
						return
					end

					local liveTargetPos
					if targetPart and targetPart.Parent then
						liveTargetPos = targetPart.Position
					else
						liveTargetPos = clickTarget.staticPosition
					end

					local currentPos = shot.Position
					local distToTarget = (liveTargetPos - currentPos).Magnitude

					local closestDist, closestPt = closestPointOnSegment(lastPos, currentPos, liveTargetPos)
					if closestDist <= ROCKET_DETONATE_DIST then
						OnTouched(shot, nil, closestPt)
						return
					end

					if not terminalLock and distToTarget <= ROCKET_TERMINAL_LOCK_DIST then
						terminalLock = true
					end

					if terminalLock then
						local lockVec = liveTargetPos - currentPos
						if lockVec.Magnitude > 0.01 then
							local dir = lockVec.Unit

							local forwardDot = dir:Dot(shot.CFrame.LookVector)
							if forwardDot < -0.5 and distToTarget < ROCKET_OVERSHOOT_DIST then
								OnTouched(shot, nil, currentPos)
								return
							end

							gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentPos, currentPos + dir)
							bodyVelocity.Velocity = dir * SHOT_SPEED
						else
							OnTouched(shot, nil, currentPos)
							return
						end
					else
						local steerTargetPos = liveTargetPos
						local toTargetSteer = steerTargetPos - currentPos
						local finalDir = shot.CFrame.LookVector

						if toTargetSteer.Magnitude > 0.5 then
							local desiredDir = toTargetSteer.Unit
							finalDir = desiredDir

							local probeLen = math.min(
								ROCKET_OBSTACLE_LOOKAHEAD,
								math.max(0, distToTarget - 4))

							if probeLen >= 5 then
								local blend = 0

								if committedAvoidDir and os.clock() < committedAvoidUntil then
									local probe = Workspace:Raycast(
										currentPos,
										desiredDir * probeLen,
										avoidParams)
									if probe and shouldDodgeObstacle(probe.Instance) then
										local d = (probe.Position - currentPos).Magnitude
										local s = math.clamp(1 - (d / probeLen), 0, 1)
										blend = ROCKET_AVOID_BLEND * (s ^ ROCKET_AVOID_RAMP_EXP)
									elseif probe then
										committedAvoidDir = nil
										blend = 0
									else
										blend = ROCKET_AVOID_BLEND
									end
									if blend > 0 then
										finalDir = (desiredDir * (1 - blend)
											+ committedAvoidDir * blend).Unit
									end
								else
									local avoidDir, avoidStrength =
										findAvoidanceDir(currentPos, desiredDir, avoidParams, probeLen)
									if avoidDir then
										committedAvoidDir = avoidDir
										committedAvoidUntil = os.clock() + ROCKET_AVOID_STICKY_TIME
										blend = ROCKET_AVOID_BLEND * avoidStrength
										finalDir = (desiredDir * (1 - blend)
											+ avoidDir * blend).Unit
									else
										committedAvoidDir = nil
									end
								end
							else
								committedAvoidDir = nil
							end

							gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentPos, currentPos + finalDir)
						end

						local speed = SHOT_SPEED
						if distToTarget < ROCKET_SLOWDOWN_DIST then
							local t = distToTarget / ROCKET_SLOWDOWN_DIST
							speed = SHOT_SPEED * math.max(ROCKET_MIN_SPEED_FRACTION, t)
						end

						local curForward = shot.CFrame.LookVector
						local alignment = math.clamp(curForward:Dot(finalDir), 0, 1)
						local cornerFactor = ROCKET_CORNER_MIN_SPEED
							+ (1 - ROCKET_CORNER_MIN_SPEED) * alignment
						speed = speed * cornerFactor

						bodyVelocity.Velocity = curForward * speed
					end

					lastPos = currentPos

					if whoosh and whoosh.Parent then
						local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
						if cam then
							local dist = (currentPos - cam.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
							local alpha
							if dist <= WHOOSH_FADE_START then
								alpha = 1
							elseif dist >= WHOOSH_FADE_END then
								alpha = 0
							else
								alpha = 1 - ((dist - WHOOSH_FADE_START) / (WHOOSH_FADE_END - WHOOSH_FADE_START))
							end
							whoosh.Volume = WHOOSH_START_VOLUME * alpha
							if alpha <= 0 then
								whoosh:Stop()
							end
						end
					end
				end)
				ActiveUpdateConn = updateConn

				shot.Destroying:Connect(function()
					if updateConn then updateConn:Disconnect() end
					if ActiveUpdateConn == updateConn then ActiveUpdateConn = nil end
					if whoosh then
						whoosh:Stop()
						whoosh:Destroy()
						if ActiveWhoosh == whoosh then ActiveWhoosh = nil end
					end
				end)

				whoosh:Play()

				shot.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart)
					OnTouched(shot, otherPart)
				end)
				DebrisService:AddItem(shot, SHOT_TIME)
				shot.Parent = Tool

				task.delay(SHOT_TIME + 0.1, function()
					if ActiveShot == shot then
						cleanupActive()
					end
				end)

				wait(0)
				ReloadSound:Play()
				wait(2)
				Tool.Enabled = true
			end
		end

		BaseShot = Instance.new('Part')
		BaseShot.Name = 'Rocket'
		BaseShot.FormFactor = Enum.FormFactor.Custom
		BaseShot.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
		BaseShot.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)

		BaseShot.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic

		BaseShot.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth

		local rocketMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")

		rocketMesh.MeshId = ROCKET_MESH_ID
		rocketMesh.Scale = ROCKET_MESH_SCALE

		rocketFire.Parent = BaseShot

		Tool.Equipped:Connect(OnEquipped)
		Tool.Activated:Connect(OnActivated)
	end, ToolScript)
end))

	end
	return nil
end

local function updateLineNumbers(textBox)

		t.frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
		t.label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)

	tab.label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
	currentTab = tab
	updateLineNumbers(tab.textBox)

local function closeTab(tab)
	if #tabs <= 1 then return end
	local idx
	for i, t in ipairs(tabs) do if t == tab then idx = i break end end
	if not idx then return end
	tab.frame:Destroy()
	tab.textBox:Destroy()
	table.remove(tabs, idx)
	if currentTab == tab then switchToTab(tabs[math.min(idx, #tabs)]) end
end

local function createTab()
	if #tabs >= MAX_TABS then return end
	local num = getNextTabNumber()
	if not num then return end
	local tab = { number = num }

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")

	textBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	textBox.Visible = false
	tab.textBox = textBox

	textBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		if currentTab == tab then updateLineNumbers(textBox) end
	end)

	label.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() switchToTab(tab) end)
	table.insert(tabs, tab)
	switchToTab(tab)
	return tab
end

local function runCode(code)
	if not code or code == "" or code:match("^%s*$") then return end
	local chunk, err = loadstring(code)
	if chunk then
		local ok, msg = pcall(chunk)

			hrp.CFrame = targetHrp.CFrame

local function isInside(pos, guiObject)
    if not guiObject.Visible then return false end
    local tl = guiObject.AbsolutePosition
    local br = tl + guiObject.AbsoluteSize
    return pos.X >= tl.X and pos.X <= br.X and pos.Y >= tl.Y and pos.Y <= br.Y
end

local function triggerDrop(tool)

    tool.Parent = workspace

        local character = player.Character
        local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then
            task.wait()
            handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 15) + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)

    end

    for tool in pairs(currentTools) do
        if not table.find(hotbarList, tool) and not table.find(inventoryList, tool) then

            if not dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                dragging = true
                dragInput = input
                dragStart = input.Position
            end
        end)

        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if dragging and input == dragInput then
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                if delta.Magnitude >= clickThreshold then
                    if not ghostBtn then
                        ghostBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
                        ghostBtn.Size = btn.Size
                        ghostBtn.Text = tool.Name

                        btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.8
                    end

                end
            end
        end)

        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if dragging and input == dragInput then
                dragging = false
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart

                if ghostBtn then
                    local dropPos = input.Position
                    ghostBtn:Destroy()
                    ghostBtn = nil

                    if isInside(dropPos, dropBox) then
                        local invIdx = table.find(inventoryList, tool)
                        if invIdx then table.remove(inventoryList, invIdx) end
                        local hotIdx = table.find(hotbarList, tool)
                        if hotIdx then table.remove(hotbarList, hotIdx) end
                        triggerDrop(tool)
                    elseif isInside(dropPos, hotbarFrame) then

                            local invIdx = table.find(inventoryList, tool)
                            if invIdx then table.remove(inventoryList, invIdx) end
                            
                            if #hotbarList >= MAX_HOTBAR then

                            local hotIdx = table.find(hotbarList, tool)
                            if hotIdx then table.remove(hotbarList, hotIdx) end
                            table.insert(inventoryList, tool)
                        end
                    end
                    renderUI() 
                else
                    if delta.Magnitude < clickThreshold then
                        if parentFrame == invScroll then
                            local currentTick = tick()
                            if currentTick - lastClickTick < 0.35 then
                                if #hotbarList < MAX_HOTBAR then
                                    local invIdx = table.find(inventoryList, tool)

                                        table.insert(hotbarList, tool)
                                        renderUI()
                                    end

                            else

                            end
                        else

                            else humanoid:EquipTool(tool) end
                            renderUI()
                        end
                    end
                end
                dragInput = nil
            end
        end)
    end

    for _, tool in ipairs(hotbarList) do createSlot(tool, hotbarFrame) end
    for _, tool in ipairs(inventoryList) do 
        if currentSearchText == "" or string.find(string.lower(tool.Name), currentSearchText, 1, true) then

scripts.title: Anti-Bang (BEST) open-source
scripts.features: For those infinite yield skids that bangs you
scripts.script:
if _G.AntiBang_Shutdown then
    pcall(_G.AntiBang_Shutdown)
    _G.AntiBang_Shutdown = nil
end

local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local StarterGui       = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- {{ toggle }}

local CONFIG = {
    ENABLED = true, -- turn anti off or on (use true or false)
}

local NOTIFY = true -- notify if it succeeded (use true or false)

local function getTorso(char)
    if not char then return nil end
    return char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function getRoot(char)
    if not char then return nil end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return (hum and hum.RootPart) or char.PrimaryPart
end

local function notify(title, text)
    if not NOTIFY then return end
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = title, Text = text, Duration = 3
        })
    end)
end

local function matchesBangFingerprint(plr, myTorso)
    local theirChar = plr.Character
    if not theirChar then return false end

    local theirHRP = theirChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not theirHRP then return false end

    local localOffset = myTorso.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(theirHRP.Position)

    if math.abs(localOffset.X) > 0.25 then return false end
    if math.abs(localOffset.Y) > 0.25 then return false end
    if math.abs(localOffset.Z - 1.1) > 0.25 then return false end

    local dot = theirHRP.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(myTorso.CFrame.LookVector)
    if dot < 0.995 then return false end

    return true
end

local dipBusy = false
local function voidDip()
    if dipBusy then return end
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar then return end
    local root = getRoot(myChar)
    if not root or not root.Parent then return end

    dipBusy = true
    local savedCF = root.CFrame
    local savedDH = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight

    workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = -1e9

    local t0 = tick()
    pcall(function()
        while tick() - t0 < 0.15 do
            if not root.Parent then break end
            root.CFrame                  = CFrame.new(0, -800, 0)
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            task.wait()
        end
    end)

    if root.Parent then
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.CFrame                  = savedCF
        local hum = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end
    end

    task.wait()
    workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = savedDH
    dipBusy = false
end

local confirmCount = {}
local lastAction   = 0

local steppedConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if not CONFIG.ENABLED then return end
    if dipBusy then return end

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar then return end
    local myTorso = getTorso(myChar)
    if not myTorso then return end

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
            if matchesBangFingerprint(plr, myTorso) then
                confirmCount[plr] = (confirmCount[plr] or 0) + 1

                if confirmCount[plr] >= 5 then
                    confirmCount[plr] = 0

                    if tick() - lastAction < 1.5 then
                        return
                    end
                    lastAction = tick()

                    notify("Anti-Bang", "Bang confirmed from " .. plr.Name)
                    voidDip()
                    return
                end
            else
                confirmCount[plr] = 0
            end
        end
    end
end)

local inputConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then
        CONFIG.ENABLED = not CONFIG.ENABLED
        notify("Anti-Bang", CONFIG.ENABLED and "Enabled" or "Disabled")
    end
end)

local removeConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
    confirmCount[plr] = nil
end)

local charConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    confirmCount = {}
    dipBusy      = false
end)

_G.AntiBang_Shutdown = function()
    steppedConn:Disconnect()
    inputConn:Disconnect()
    removeConn:Disconnect()
    charConn:Disconnect()
end

_G.AntiBang_Toggle = function(state)
    if type(state) == "boolean" then
        CONFIG.ENABLED = state
    else
        CONFIG.ENABLED = not CONFIG.ENABLED
    end
    notify("Anti-Bang", CONFIG.ENABLED and "Enabled" or "Disabled")
end

local function makePicker(par, pos, startColor, onChange)
	local api = {}
	local h, s, v = startColor:ToHSV()
	local color = startColor
	local open, queued = false, false
	local swatch = make("TextButton", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Size = offset(26, 26), Position = pos, BackgroundColor3 = color, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0}, par)
	local pop = make("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Size = offset(190, 196), Position = udim(0.5, 0, 1, 6), BackgroundColor3 = bgCol, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false}, frame)
	local popBase = stroke(pop, rgb(225, 225, 232), 2)
	local popStroke = stroke(pop, white, 2)
	local popGrad = make("UIGradient", {Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, 0.5), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.48, 0),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, 0.5), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.98, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})}, popStroke)
	local popScale = make("UIScale", {}, pop)
	local svBox = make("Frame", {Size = offset(170, 96), Position = offset(10, 10), BackgroundColor3 = white, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true}, pop)
	local svGrad = make("UIGradient", {}, svBox)
	local darkOverlay = make("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2}, svBox)
	local hueSlider = make("Frame", {Size = offset(170, 20), Position = offset(10, 112), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Active = true}, pop)
	local hueBar = make("Frame", {Size = udim(1, 0, 0, 10), Position = udim(0, 0, 0.5, -5), BackgroundColor3 = white, BorderSizePixel = 0}, hueSlider)
	local previewDot = make("Frame", {Size = offset(24, 24), Position = offset(10, 162), BackgroundColor3 = color, BorderSizePixel = 0}, pop)
	local rgbInput = make("TextBox", {Size = offset(130, 24), Position = offset(50, 162), BackgroundColor3 = rgb(238, 238, 243), BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = cartoon, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = inkCol, PlaceholderText = "255, 0, 0", PlaceholderColor3 = rgb(150, 150, 160), ClearTextOnFocus = false, Text = "255, 0, 0"}, pop)
	local svKnob, hueKnob = makeKnob(svBox, 3, color), makeKnob(hueSlider, 2, color)
	local inputStroke = stroke(rgbInput, lineCol, 1.5)
	local spinTween = TS:Create(popGrad, TweenInfo.new(2, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.In, -1), {Rotation = 360})

	make("UIGradient", {Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1, 0), Rotation = 90}, darkOverlay)
	make("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, rgb(255, 0, 0)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1 / 6, rgb(255, 255, 0)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(2 / 6, rgb(0, 255, 0)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(3 / 6, rgb(0, 255, 255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(4 / 6, rgb(0, 0, 255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(5 / 6, rgb(255, 0, 255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, rgb(255, 0, 0)),
	})}, hueBar)
	corner(swatch, 0, 8)
	stroke(swatch, inkCol, 1.5, 0.6)
	corner(pop, 0, 12)
	corner(svBox, 0, 8)
	corner(darkOverlay, 0, 8)
	corner(hueBar, 1)
	corner(previewDot, 1)
	stroke(previewDot, inkCol, 1, 0.6)
	corner(rgbInput, 0, 8)

	local function paint()
		color = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v)
		swatch.BackgroundColor3 = color
		previewDot.BackgroundColor3 = color
		svKnob.BackgroundColor3 = color
		hueKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, 1)
		svGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(white, Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, 1))
		popGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, accent), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.48, color), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, accent),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.98, color), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, accent),
		})
		svKnob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(s, 1 - v)
		hueKnob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(h, 0.5)
		rgbInput.Text = string.format("%d, %d, %d", math.round(color.R * 255), math.round(color.G * 255), math.round(color.B * 255))
	end

	local function changed()
		if queued then
			return
		end
		queued = true
		task.defer(function()
			queued = false
			paint()
			onChange(color)
		end)
	end

	for i, c in presetColors do
		local chip = make("TextButton", {Size = offset(16, 16), Position = offset(10 + (i - 1) * 22, 138), BackgroundColor3 = c, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0}, pop)
		corner(chip, 1)
		stroke(chip, inkCol, 1, 0.6)
		chip.Activated:Connect(function()
			h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
			changed()
		end)
	end

	local function idk(i, name)
		if name == "sv" then
			s = math.clamp((i.Position.X - svBox.AbsolutePosition.X) / svBox.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
			v = 1 - math.clamp((i.Position.Y - svBox.AbsolutePosition.Y) / svBox.AbsoluteSize.Y, 0, 1)
		else
			h = math.clamp((i.Position.X - hueSlider.AbsolutePosition.X) / hueSlider.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 0.999)
		end
		changed()
	end

	local function bindSlider(fr, name)
		fr.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
			if not isPress(i) then
				return
			end
			idk(i, name)
			startDrag(i, function(m)
				idk(m, name)
			end)
		end)
	end
	bindSlider(svBox, "sv")
	bindSlider(hueSlider, "hue")

	rgbInput.Focused:Connect(function()
		TS:Create(inputStroke, fast, {Color = accent}):Play()
	end)

	rgbInput.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		TS:Create(inputStroke, fast, {Color = lineCol}):Play()
		local r, g, b = rgbInput.Text:match("(%d+)%D+(%d+)%D+(%d+)")
		if r then
			h, s, v = rgb(math.clamp(tonumber(r), 0, 255), math.clamp(tonumber(g), 0, 255), math.clamp(tonumber(b), 0, 255)):ToHSV()
		end
		changed()
	end)

	local function WHAT(state)
		open = state
		if state then
			for _, p in pickers do
				if p ~= api then
					p.close()
				end
			end
			pop.Visible = true
			popScale.Scale = 0.9
			pop.Position = udim(0.5, 0, 1, -4)
			popStroke.Transparency = 1
			popBase.Transparency = 1
			popGrad.Rotation = 0
			TS:Create(popScale, popTi, {Scale = 1}):Play()
			TS:Create(pop, popTi, {Position = udim(0.5, 0, 1, 6)}):Play()
			TS:Create(popStroke, popTi, {Transparency = 0}):Play()
			TS:Create(popBase, popTi, {Transparency = 0}):Play()
			spinTween:Play()
		else
			pop.Visible = false
			spinTween:Cancel()
		end
	end

	swatch.Activated:Connect(function()
		WHAT(not open)
	end)

	api.close = function()
		WHAT(false)
	end
	table.insert(pickers, api)
	paint()
	return api
end

local function sync(player)
	local d = espData[player]
	if not d then
		return
	end
	local c = colorFor(player)
	if isOn and hlOn then
		if not d.hl then
			d.hl = make("Highlight", {Adornee = d.char, FillColor = c, OutlineColor = c, FillTransparency = 0.5, DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop}, idkFolder)
		end
	elseif d.hl then
		d.hl:Destroy()
		d.hl = nil
	end
	local key = (isOn and unOn and 1 or 0) + (isOn and tnOn and 2 or 0)
	if key ~= d.key and (key == 0 or d.hd) then
		if d.bb then
			d.bb:Destroy()
			d.bb, d.tag, d.teamTag = nil, nil, nil
		end
		d.key = key
		if key > 0 then
			local both = key == 3
			d.bb = make("BillboardGui", {Adornee = d.hd, Size = offset(120, both and 40 or 20), StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, both and 3 or 2.5, 0), AlwaysOnTop = true}, idkFolder)
			if key >= 2 then
				d.teamTag = make("TextLabel", {Size = udim(1, 0, 0, 20), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = teamText(player), Font = cartoon, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = c, TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4}, d.bb)
			end
			if key % 2 == 1 then
				d.tag = make("TextLabel", {Size = udim(1, 0, 0, 20), Position = offset(0, both and 20 or 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = player.DisplayName, Font = cartoon, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = c, TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4}, d.bb)
			end
		end
	end
	if isOn and boxOn then
		if d.root and not d.boxGui then
			d.boxGui = make("BillboardGui", {Adornee = d.root, Size = UDim2.new(4.5, 0, 6, 0), AlwaysOnTop = true}, idkFolder)
			d.boxStroke = stroke(make("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, d.boxGui), c, 1.5)
		end
	elseif d.boxGui then
		d.boxGui:Destroy()
		d.boxGui, d.boxStroke = nil, nil
	end
	if isOn and tracerOn then
		if d.root and not d.line then
			d.line = make("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = offset(2, 0), BackgroundColor3 = c, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false}, tracerGui)
		end
	elseif d.line then
		d.line:Destroy()
		d.line, d.px, d.py = nil, nil, nil
	end
end

local function updateLines()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local vs = cam.ViewportSize
	local ax, ay = vs.X / 2, vs.Y
	for _, d in espData do
		local line = d.line
		if line then
			local rt = d.root
			local show = false
			if rt and rt.Parent then
				local p = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(rt.Position)
				if p.Z > 0 then
					show = true
					if d.px ~= p.X or d.py ~= p.Y then
						d.px, d.py = p.X, p.Y
						local dx, dy = p.X - ax, p.Y - ay
						line.Position = offset(ax + dx / 2, ay + dy / 2)
						line.Size = offset(2, math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy))
						line.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx)) - 90
					end
				else
					d.px = nil
				end
			end
			if line.Visible ~= show then
				line.Visible = show
			end
		end
	end
end

local function refresh()
	if isOn then
		if addConn then
			for player in espData do
				sync(player)
			end
		else
			for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
				trackPlayer(player)
			end
			addConn = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(trackPlayer)
			remConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
				dropConns(player)
				clearEsp(player)
			end)
		end
	elseif addConn then
		addConn:Disconnect()
		remConn:Disconnect()
		addConn, remConn = nil, nil
		for player in woahjConns do
			dropConns(player)
		end
		for player in espData do
			clearEsp(player)
		end
	end
	if isOn and tracerOn and not lineConn then
		lineConn = RS.RenderStepped:Connect(updateLines)
	elseif not (isOn and tracerOn) and lineConn then
		lineConn:Disconnect()
		lineConn = nil
	end
end
